contract.task_clause:
A medical research team tests for tumor reduction in a sample of patients using three different dosages of an experimental cancer drug. Which of the following is true?
Option A: There are three explanatory variables and one response variable.
Option B: There is one explanatory variable with three levels of response.
Option C: Tumor reduction is the only explanatory variable, but there are three response variables corresponding to the different dosages.
Option D: There are three levels of a single explanatory variable.
